# Next.js App Router — Type Definitions

For schema-field comments and JSDoc rules, see `comments.md`. This file focuses on type-definition mechanics and placement.

---

## Where to put type definitions

| Type | Location | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Form schema and type | `app/(app)/{feature}/[id]/edit/form.ts` (or `{feature}/new/form.ts`) | `ResourceFormSchema`, `ResourceFormType` |
| Shared form/validation primitives | `app/(core)/schema.ts` | `DisplayIdSchema`, `BirthdaySchema` |
| API request/response types | `app/api/{resource}/route.ts` (export from handler) | `PostResourceRequest`, `GetResourceListResponse` |
| API query parameter types | `app/api/{resource}/query.ts` | `ResourceFilterType` |
| DB row types | `drizzle/schema.ts` (via `$inferSelect` / `$inferInsert`) | `ResourceSelect`, `ResourceInsert` |
| Component Props | Inside the component file (no export needed) | `type Props = { resourceId: string }` |
| Hook return / argument types | Inside the hook file (no export needed) | Inline in function signature |
| Domain types reused across features | `app/(core)/types.ts` (when shared by 3+ files) | `SortOrder`, `Pagination` |

> No global `types.d.ts`. Types live next to the code that owns them.

---

## type vs interface

Use `type` by default. `interface` is reserved for cases where declaration merging or library extension is required (rare in app code).

```ts
// ✅ Use type for everything
type Props = { resourceId: string }
type SortOrder = "asc" | "desc"
type Context = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
type ResourceSort = { column: ResourceColumn; order: SortOrder }

// ⚠️ Only use interface when extending a library's interface
interface CustomTheme extends MantineTheme { /* ... */ }
```

Always document each field with `/** ... */` (see `comments.md`).

---

## Zod schema → Type inference

Define schema with Zod, then infer the type. **Do not write the type by hand** — always infer it from the schema.

```ts
import { z } from "zod"

/** リソース登録フォームスキーマ */
export const ResourceFormSchema = z.object({
  /** リソース名（1〜20 文字、必須） */
  name: z.string().nonempty().min(1).max(20),
  /** 公開フラグ */
  isPublic: z.boolean(),
  /** タグ（最大 10 件） */
  tags: z.array(z.string()).max(10),
})

/** リソース登録フォーム型（推論） */
export type ResourceFormType = z.infer<typeof ResourceFormSchema>
```

### Why inference

- Schema and type can never go out of sync
- Refactoring the schema automatically updates the type
- Smaller diffs on schema changes

---

## Schema composition

### Extending a base schema

```ts
// Base
export const BaseResourceFormSchema = z.object({
  /** リソース名 */
  name: z.string().nonempty(),
  /** アイコン ID */
  iconId: z.number(),
})

// Extension
export const PremiumResourceFormSchema = BaseResourceFormSchema.extend({
  /** 有料プラン ID */
  planId: z.string(),
})
export type PremiumResourceFormType = z.infer<typeof PremiumResourceFormSchema>
```

### Cross-field validation with `.refine()`

```ts
export const PasswordResetSchema = z.object({
  password: z.string().min(6),
  passwordConfirm: z.string().nonempty(),
})
.refine((data) => data.password === data.passwordConfirm, {
  message: "パスワードが一致しません。",
  path: ["passwordConfirm"],  // attach error to this field
})
```

`path: ["fieldName"]` attaches the error to a specific field so `errors.fieldName?.message` picks it up.

### Reusable refinement helper

When the same `.refine()` is applied to multiple schemas:

```ts
/** 開始 < 終了 のバリデーションを追加する共通 refine */
export const addRangeRefinement = <T extends z.ZodObject<z.ZodRawShape>>(
  schema: T,
  fromKey: string,
  toKey: string,
) => schema.refine(
  (data) => data[fromKey] == null || data[toKey] == null || data[fromKey] < data[toKey],
  { message: "開始は終了より小さい必要があります", path: [fromKey] }
)

export const ResourceFormSchema = addRangeRefinement(
  BaseResourceFormSchema.extend({ /* ... */ }),
  "ageFrom", "ageTo"
)
```

## Drizzle types

Drizzle ORM provides `$inferSelect` and `$inferInsert` to derive types from table definitions.

```ts
// drizzle/schema.ts
export const resources = pgTable("resources", {
  /** ID */
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey(),
  /** リソース名 */
  name: text("name").notNull(),
  /** 表示 ID */
  displayId: text("display_id").notNull(),
})

// Select type (matches `SELECT * FROM resources`)
export type ResourceSelect = typeof resources.$inferSelect

// Insert type (matches `INSERT INTO resources`)
export type ResourceInsert = Omit<typeof resources.$inferInsert, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">

// Update type
export type ResourceUpdate = Partial<ResourceInsert>
```

### Common derivations

```ts
// Exclude auto-managed columns from Insert
export type ResourceInsert = Omit<typeof resources.$inferInsert, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">

// Exclude immutable fields from Update
export type ResourceUpdate = Omit<Partial<ResourceInsert>, "type">

// Composite return types
export type ResourceWithChildren = {
  resource: ResourceSelect
  children: ResourceChildSelect[]
  tags:     ResourceTagSelect[]
}
```

Every column in `drizzle/schema.ts` requires a `/** ... */` description (see `comments.md`).

## API request/response types

### Request type (defined in `route.ts`)

```ts
// app/api/resources/route.ts
import { z } from "zod"

export const PostResourceRequestSchema = z.object({
  form: ResourceFormSchema,
})
export type PostResourceRequest = z.infer<typeof PostResourceRequestSchema>

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  // ...
  const data = PostResourceRequestSchema.parse(body)
}
```

### Client uses the request type

```ts
// app/api/resources/client.ts
import type { PostResourceRequest } from "./route"

export const postResource = async (request: PostResourceRequest) => { /* ... */ }
```

### Response type via `Awaited<ReturnType<...>>`

```ts
// app/api/resources/[id]/route.ts
const fetchResource = async ({ db, id }) => {
  return await db.query.resources.findFirst({ where: eq(resources.id, id) })
}

export type GetResourceResponse = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof fetchResource>>
```

## Generics

Use generics for reusable layouts and hooks operating on a polymorphic form type.

```tsx
// Generic layout for any form type
type EditLayoutProps<TForm extends Record<string, unknown>> = {
  /** リソース ID（新規作成時は undefined） */
  resourceId?: string
  /** ローディング状態 */
  isLoading: boolean
  /** 送信ハンドラ */
  onSubmit: (e?: React.BaseSyntheticEvent) => Promise<void>
  /** タブ設定 */
  tabs: TabConfig[]
}

export const EditLayout = <TForm extends Record<string, unknown>>({
  resourceId, isLoading, onSubmit, tabs,
}: EditLayoutProps<TForm>) => {
  // ...
}

// Usage
<EditLayout<ResourceFormType>
  resourceId={resourceId}
  // ...
/>
```

```ts
// Generic mutation hook
const mutation = useMutation<void, unknown, ResourceFormType>({
  mutationFn: async (data) => await putResource(resourceId, data),
  // ...
})
```

## Type imports

Always use `import type` for types-only imports. This makes it explicit at the import site that nothing runtime is being pulled in.

```ts
// ✅ Type-only import
import type { PostResourceRequest } from "./route"
import type { ResourceFormType } from "../form"
import type { Resource } from "@/drizzle/schema"

// ❌ Don't use a runtime import for a type
import { PostResourceRequest } from "./route"
```

---

## Constraints

- Always infer types from Zod schemas (`z.infer<>`) — never write parallel manual types
- Always use `import type` for type-only imports
- Default to `type`; use `interface` only for library extension
- Component `Props` types are local (not exported) unless reused
- DB types come from `drizzle/schema.ts` via `$inferSelect` / `$inferInsert`
- Every type field has a `/** ... */` description (see `comments.md`)
- Every Drizzle column has a `/** ... */` description (see `comments.md`)
